review: Fresh actual image-model review of active round2 person parts
criteria: Each of medium,line,light,palette is an integer 1-5; pass requires all >=4
limitations: Both anchors are overlapping crops of the same person_v2 source, not independent images.
Style scores do not establish readability, animation quality, numeric pass or final production acceptance.
Three independently identified candidates per call due runtime maximum5 reference paths; last call has one candidate.
Native raw crops retain magenta background and occasional neighbor fragments; prompt excludes background and unrelated edge fragments.
Numeric scores transcribed by reviewer from actual generated scorecards; reason_summary paraphrases the raw card.
Numeric whole-person references may penalize small isolated parts through foreground-normalized line density or wash variance; failures are retained without retuning.
rejected_reason: referenced_image_paths must contain at most5 paths; first attempted batch8 exceeded runtime limit
production_acceptance: Model AND frozen numeric judge v2, same-family verified, all calibration folds pass
